postings.title: Coherent DSP Applications Engineer
top_requirements: Design and implement coherent optical DSP algorithms and verify them on ASIC prototypes from simulation through hardware bring‑up.
Develop and maintain end‑to‑end test benches for high‑speed DSP blocks, including link‑budget analysis, eye‑diagram measurement, and EVM validation.
Collaborate with hardware and firmware teams to integrate DSP IP into optical transceiver modules and troubleshoot performance issues in the lab.
postings.summary: The role builds and validates coherent optical DSP solutions, bridging lab prototypes to customer deployments. It matches the candidate’s hands‑on DSP, modem, and RF system experience while moving into silicon‑photonic IC work.

postings.title: Senior Staff Electrical Engineer
top_requirements: Lead the design of high‑performance mixed‑signal ASIC blocks for audio and communication pipelines, from specification to silicon validation.
Perform RF front‑end analysis including noise figure, gain, IIP3, and EVM across the full signal chain for Dolby’s audio codecs.
Create and execute automated test frameworks for silicon bring‑up, characterization, and regression of communication‑related IP.
postings.summary: Dolby’s Senior Staff Electrical Engineer role focuses on mixed‑signal ASIC design for audio‑communication systems, offering a senior technical path aligned with the candidate’s RF and modem background.

postings.title: Audio DSP & Tuning Engineer
top_requirements: Develop and tune real‑time audio DSP pipelines for in‑vehicle infotainment, including equalization, noise reduction, and spatial rendering.
Implement and validate high‑performance audio codecs on embedded DSP processors, ensuring low latency and power efficiency.
Create automated test suites to measure audio quality metrics such as THD, SNR, and subjective listening tests.
postings.summary: This position designs and optimizes audio DSP algorithms for Rivian’s vehicles, leveraging the candidate’s signal‑processing expertise while staying in a hands‑on engineering role.

postings.title: Embedded Software Engineer, DSP
top_requirements: Design and implement embedded DSP algorithms for underwater acoustic modems, covering modulation, error correction, and adaptive equalization.
Develop firmware for real‑time audio‑signal processing on low‑power microcontrollers, integrating sensor data and handling harsh acoustic channel conditions.
Perform system‑level testing in underwater environments, including link‑budget analysis, SNR measurement, and reliability validation.
postings.summary: OceanComm’s Embedded Software Engineer role focuses on acoustic communication modems, offering a direct application of the candidate’s RF and modem design skills in a new domain.

postings.title: Mixed Signal IC Layout Designer
top_requirements: Create full‑custom mixed‑signal IC layouts for analog/RF blocks, adhering to design rules for advanced CMOS processes.
Perform parasitic extraction, signal‑integrity analysis, and layout‑versus‑schematic (LVS) verification for high‑frequency circuits.
Collaborate with circuit designers to optimize layout for noise, matching, and gain performance in communication‑centric ASICs.
postings.summary: The Mixed‑Signal IC Layout Designer role at Cirrus Logic is a pure IC‑design position that leverages the candidate’s RF and communication background in a hands‑on layout capacity.
